list_search_tools: list all search tools available in the database and config file
create_search_tool: create a new search tool with name, litellm params, and optional info in the database
update_search_tool: update an existing search tool identified by its ID in the database
delete_search_tool: delete a search tool from the database by its ID
test_search_tool_connection: test connection to a search provider with given litellm params to verify API key validity
